title: Noterdamian Traditions & Bittersweet Farewell
subtitle: The 8:10 AM Gate Rule, Room 304, and Campus Brotherhood
body: Notre Dame College was defined by its legendary discipline—the strict 8:10 AM gate closure, short hair, uniform inspections, and the brotherhood of Batch '19 (Group 13, Room 304) navigating the labyrinth of Harrington Building, Ganguly Building, Father Timm Building, and Fr. Peixotto Building. On the final day, classes concluded not with celebratory chaos, but with heartfelt parting speeches from our mentors and teachers. Leaving Room 304 and stepping through the college gates marked the transition to adulthood and engineering.
